description: Delete one of the person's own styles for good. It can't be undone, and templates in that style stop opening. Without confirm: true it only says what will go; ask the person first. Dinoctor reloads afterwards. Built-in styles can't be deleted. To only stop using it, switch with use_style instead.

confirm.description: true only after the person said to delete it.

id.description: The person's own style id from my_styles (built-in styles can't be used here).

name: delete_style
